Complete Common Stan Control Options for Bayesian Methods

Source: R/controls.R
complete_control_bayes_common.Rd

This function completes the control options list for Bayesian methods by setting the number of iterations, refresh rate, and initial values based on the provided arguments.

Usage 

complete_control_bayes_common(
  control,
  n_samples,
  quiet,
  outcome = c("continuous", "count")
)

Arguments

control

A list containing part of the control options. Must not contain iter, refresh, object, data, or pars.

n_samples

Number of samples to be drawn.

quiet

A logical indicating whether to suppress output during sampling.

outcome

Outcome type used to resolve the initialisation policy.

Value

A completed control options list including computed iter and refresh values and resolved init. The initialisation attribute retains the resolved policy before model-specific expansion of starting values.
